items.question: Trong câu "Moving from understanding to action takes a deliberate effort — and that effort is process improvement.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Moving from understanding to action takes a deliberate effort — and that effort is process improvement.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (tính từ): có chủ ý. "A deliberate effort" = một nỗ lực có chủ đích; kiến thức không tự biến thành thực hành.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (adjective): done on purpose. "A deliberate effort" is an intentional one; knowledge does not turn into practice by itself.

items.question: Trong câu "Knowledge does not convert itself into practice.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Knowledge does not convert itself into practice.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển hóa, biến thành. Cấu trúc "convert A into B" = biến A thành B.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into something else. The pattern is "convert A into B" — to turn A into B.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements problems are the most common source of expensive software defects.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements problems are the most common source of expensive software defects.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Software defect" = lỗi phần mềm; lỗi yêu cầu thường là lỗi đắt nhất.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. "Software defect" means a bug or flaw; requirements defects are usually the costliest.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of fixing them grows exponentially with the phase of discovery.", từ "exponentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of fixing them grows exponentially with the phase of discovery.", what does "exponentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: exponentially /ˌek.spəˈnen.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): theo cấp số nhân. "Grow exponentially" = tăng theo cấp số nhân, tức tăng rất nhanh.
items.explanationEn: exponentially /ˌek.spəˈnen.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): at a rapidly multiplying rate. "Grow exponentially" means to increase faster and faster.

items.question: Trong câu "Rework consumes a very large share of total project effort", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rework consumes a very large share of total project effort", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriː.wɜːk/ (danh từ): việc làm lại. Rework là công sức phải bỏ ra để sửa lại thứ đã làm sai.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriː.wɜːk/ (noun): work redone to fix it. Rework is effort spent redoing something that was done wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Rework consumes a very large share of total project effort", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rework consumes a very large share of total project effort", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn. "Consume time/effort/memory" = tiêu tốn thời gian/công sức/bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume time, effort or memory" means to use it up.

items.question: Trong câu "most of that rework traces back to wrong or missing requirements", từ "trace back to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "most of that rework traces back to wrong or missing requirements", what does "trace back to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: trace back to /treɪs bæk tuː/ (cụm từ): bắt nguồn từ. "X traces back to Y" = X có nguồn gốc từ Y.
items.explanationEn: trace back to /treɪs bæk tuː/ (phrase): to originate from. "X traces back to Y" means Y is where X originally came from.

items.question: Trong câu "simply because you are attacking the source rather than the symptoms.", từ "symptom" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "simply because you are attacking the source rather than the symptoms.", what does "symptom" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a visible sign of a problem
items.explanation: symptom /ˈsɪmp.təm/ (danh từ): triệu chứng, biểu hiện. Đối lập thường gặp: symptom (biểu hiện) và root cause (nguyên nhân gốc).
items.explanationEn: symptom /ˈsɪmp.təm/ (noun): a visible sign of a problem. A common contrast is symptom (visible sign) versus root cause.

items.question: Trong câu "Certification can be a side effect, but the goal is better business outcomes, not a certificate on the wall.", từ "side effect" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Certification can be a side effect, but the goal is better business outcomes, not a certificate on the wall.", what does "side effect" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (cụm từ): hệ quả phụ. "Side effect" = kết quả phụ, không phải mục đích chính; trong lập trình còn chỉ tác dụng phụ của hàm.
items.explanationEn: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (phrase): a secondary result. "Side effect" is a secondary result, not the main aim; in programming it also means a function's extra effect.

items.question: Trong câu "Improvement imposed on a team from outside almost always fails.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Improvement imposed on a team from outside almost always fails.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "Impose something on someone" = áp đặt điều gì lên ai.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force on someone. "Impose something on someone" means to force it on them.

items.question: Trong câu "Many organizations use a maturity model to locate themselves.", từ "maturity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many organizations use a maturity model to locate themselves.", what does "maturity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the due date of a loan
items.explanation: maturity /məˈtʃʊə.rə.ti/ (danh từ): mức độ trưởng thành. "Maturity model" = mô hình đánh giá mức độ trưởng thành của quy trình.
items.explanationEn: maturity /məˈtʃʊə.rə.ti/ (noun): level of development. "Maturity model" is a framework rating how developed a process is.

items.question: Trong câu "A team rolls out a new practice, declares success, and moves on to the next one without ever checking whether the first actually helped.", từ "declare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team rolls out a new practice, declares success, and moves on to the next one without ever checking whether the first actually helped.", what does "declare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: declare /dɪˈkleə/ (động từ): tuyên bố. "Declare success/victory" = tuyên bố thành công; trong lập trình "declare a variable" = khai báo biến.
items.explanationEn: declare /dɪˈkleə/ (verb): to announce officially. "Declare success" means to announce it; in code, "declare a variable" means to define it.

items.question: Trong câu "Roll out the change, usually starting with a pilot project.", từ "roll out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Roll out the change, usually starting with a pilot project.", what does "roll out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: roll out /rəʊl aʊt/ (cụm từ): triển khai. "Roll out a change/feature" = đưa thay đổi hoặc tính năng vào sử dụng rộng rãi.
items.explanationEn: roll out /rəʊl aʊt/ (phrase): to introduce widely. "Roll out a change or feature" means to put it into wide use.

items.question: Trong câu "Incremental improvement beats a big transformation.", từ "incremental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Incremental improvement beats a big transformation.", what does "incremental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl/ (tính từ): từng bước, tăng dần. "Incremental improvement/delivery" = cải tiến/bàn giao từng phần nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl/ (adjective): in small steps. "Incremental improvement or delivery" happens in small steps.

items.question: Trong câu "If you do not explicitly allocate time for it, it will not happen.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you do not explicitly allocate time for it, it will not happen.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set aside for a purpose
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ. "Allocate time/resources for something" = dành thời gian/nguồn lực cho việc gì.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to set aside for a purpose. "Allocate time or resources for something" means to set them aside for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Use maturity models for orientation, not for scoring.", từ "orientation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use maturity models for orientation, not for scoring.", what does "orientation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: orientation /ˌɔː.ri.enˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự định hướng. "For orientation" = để định hướng, biết mình đang ở đâu; "orientation week" = tuần nhập môn.
items.explanationEn: orientation /ˌɔː.ri.enˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): finding your position. "For orientation" means to find where you stand; "orientation week" is an induction period.

items.question: Trong câu "You can diagnose the health of a requirements process fairly accurately from its symptoms:", từ "diagnose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can diagnose the health of a requirements process fairly accurately from its symptoms:", what does "diagnose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: diagnose /ˈdaɪ.əɡ.nəʊz/ (động từ): chẩn đoán. "Diagnose a problem" = xác định vấn đề dựa trên dấu hiệu.
items.explanationEn: diagnose /ˈdaɪ.əɡ.nəʊz/ (verb): to identify a problem. "Diagnose a problem" means to identify it from its signs.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimates are consistently and badly wrong — usually because they rested on incomplete understanding.", từ "consistently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimates are consistently and badly wrong — usually because they rested on incomplete understanding.", what does "consistently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (trạng từ): luôn luôn, nhất quán. "Consistently wrong" = sai lần nào cũng như lần nào.
items.explanationEn: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (adverb): every time, reliably. "Consistently wrong" means wrong every single time.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimates are consistently and badly wrong — usually because they rested on incomplete understanding.", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimates are consistently and badly wrong — usually because they rested on incomplete understanding.", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (danh từ): ước lượng. Danh từ phát âm /ˈes.tɪ.mət/, động từ /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/; "effort estimate" = ước lượng công sức.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (noun): a rough calculation. The noun is /ˈes.tɪ.mət/, the verb /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/; "effort estimate" is a guess of work needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Important stakeholders appear only at the end of the project with new requirements.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Important stakeholders appear only at the end of the project with new requirements.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a party affected by a project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.də/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. Stakeholder là bất kỳ ai bị ảnh hưởng hoặc có quyền lợi trong dự án.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.də/ (noun): a party affected by a project. A stakeholder is anyone with an interest in or affected by the project.

items.question: Trong câu "The same kind of problem recurs on every project.", từ "recur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same kind of problem recurs on every project.", what does "recur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recur /rɪˈkɜː/ (động từ): tái diễn. "Recurring problem" = vấn đề lặp đi lặp lại; danh từ là recurrence.
items.explanationEn: recur /rɪˈkɜː/ (verb): to happen again. "Recurring problem" is one that keeps happening; the noun is recurrence.

items.question: Trong câu "The same problem across five consecutive projects is a process defect", từ "consecutive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same problem across five consecutive projects is a process defect", what does "consecutive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.tɪv/ (tính từ): liên tiếp. "Five consecutive projects" = năm dự án liền nhau.
items.explanationEn: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.tɪv/ (adjective): one after another. "Five consecutive projects" means five in a row.

items.question: Trong câu "If retrospectives are used to find someone to blame, people will not speak honestly and you will learn nothing.", từ "blame" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If retrospectives are used to find someone to blame, people will not speak honestly and you will learn nothing.", what does "blame" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: blame /bleɪm/ (động từ): đổ lỗi. "Someone to blame" = người để đổ lỗi; "blameless retrospective" = buổi nhìn lại không đổ lỗi.
items.explanationEn: blame /bleɪm/ (verb): to hold responsible. "Someone to blame" is a person held at fault; a "blameless retrospective" avoids that.

items.question: Trong câu "If a large share traces back to missing or ambiguous requirements, you know exactly what to improve.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a large share traces back to missing or ambiguous requirements, you know exactly what to improve.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. "Ambiguous requirement" = yêu cầu có thể hiểu theo nhiều cách; danh từ là ambiguity.
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): open to several meanings. "Ambiguous requirement" can be read more than one way; the noun is ambiguity.

items.question: Trong câu "Classify them: missed requirement, misunderstood requirement, genuine business change, or new idea.", từ "genuine" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classify them: missed requirement, misunderstood requirement, genuine business change, or new idea.", what does "genuine" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (tính từ): thật sự, đích thực. "Genuine business change" = thay đổi thật sự đến từ nghiệp vụ, không phải do bỏ sót.
items.explanationEn: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (adjective): real and actual. "Genuine business change" is a real change in the business, not a missed need.

items.question: Trong câu "fixing symptoms gives temporary relief; fixing root causes gives durable improvement.", từ "relief" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fixing symptoms gives temporary relief; fixing root causes gives durable improvement.", what does "relief" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: relief /rɪˈliːf/ (danh từ): sự giảm nhẹ, dễ chịu. "Temporary relief" = sự dễ chịu tạm thời, vấn đề sẽ quay lại.
items.explanationEn: relief /rɪˈliːf/ (noun): an easing of a problem. "Temporary relief" eases a problem only for a while.

items.question: Trong câu "fixing symptoms gives temporary relief; fixing root causes gives durable improvement.", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fixing symptoms gives temporary relief; fixing root causes gives durable improvement.", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (tính từ): bền vững, lâu dài. "Durable improvement" = cải tiến có tác dụng lâu dài; cũng dùng cho đồ vật bền.
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (adjective): long-lasting. "Durable improvement" lasts; the word also describes sturdy objects.

items.question: Trong câu "most root causes are PROCESS problems or PEOPLE problems, not tool problems.", từ "root cause" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "most root causes are PROCESS problems or PEOPLE problems, not tool problems.", what does "root cause" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: root cause /ruːt kɔːz/ (cụm từ): nguyên nhân gốc rễ. "Root cause analysis" = phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ, ví dụ bằng kỹ thuật "five whys".
items.explanationEn: root cause /ruːt kɔːz/ (phrase): the underlying cause. "Root cause analysis" digs to the underlying cause, e.g. with the five whys.

items.question: Trong câu "Because we have no systematic stakeholder identification step at project start.", từ "systematic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because we have no systematic stakeholder identification step at project start.", what does "systematic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: systematic /ˌsɪs.təˈmæt.ɪk/ (tính từ): có hệ thống. "Systematic step" = bước làm theo phương pháp, lặp lại được, không tùy hứng.
items.explanationEn: systematic /ˌsɪs.təˈmæt.ɪk/ (adjective): methodical and organised. "Systematic step" is methodical and repeatable, not ad hoc.

items.question: Trong câu "Fixing that prevents an entire class of problems, not one instance.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fixing that prevents an entire class of problems, not one instance.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (danh từ): trường hợp cụ thể. "Not one instance" = không chỉ một trường hợp; trong lập trình "instance" là đối tượng của lớp.
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (noun): a single case. "Not one instance" means not just one case; in OOP an instance is an object of a class.

items.question: Trong câu "It has a measurable goal.", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It has a measurable goal.", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ər.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. "Measurable goal" = mục tiêu có thể kiểm tra bằng con số.
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ər.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be measured. "Measurable goal" can be checked with numbers.

items.question: Trong câu "Point 6 is routinely skipped and is a common cause of failure.", từ "routinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Point 6 is routinely skipped and is a common cause of failure.", what does "routinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: routinely /ruːˈtiːn.li/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên, như thói quen. "Routinely skipped" = thường bị bỏ qua như một thói quen.
items.explanationEn: routinely /ruːˈtiːn.li/ (adverb): regularly, as a habit. "Routinely skipped" means habitually left out.

items.question: Trong câu "They will do it superficially, or drop it as soon as pressure rises.", từ "superficially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They will do it superficially, or drop it as soon as pressure rises.", what does "superficially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: superficially /ˌsuː.pəˈfɪʃ.əl.i/ (trạng từ): hời hợt, qua loa. "Do something superficially" = làm cho có, không đi vào thực chất.
items.explanationEn: superficially /ˌsuː.pəˈfɪʃ.əl.i/ (adverb): only on the surface. "Do something superficially" means without real depth.

items.question: Trong câu "you are adding load to an already overloaded team.", từ "overloaded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you are adding load to an already overloaded team.", what does "overloaded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overloaded /ˌəʊ.vəˈləʊ.dɪd/ (tính từ): quá tải. "Overloaded team" = đội có quá nhiều việc; trong lập trình "overloaded method" là nạp chồng hàm.
items.explanationEn: overloaded /ˌəʊ.vəˈləʊ.dɪd/ (adjective): given too much work. "Overloaded team" has too much work; in code an "overloaded method" has several signatures.

items.question: Trong câu "You find the real problems before replicating them across 20 teams.", từ "replicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You find the real problems before replicating them across 20 teams.", what does "replicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: replicate /ˈrep.lɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): nhân rộng, lặp lại. "Replicate a problem/result" = làm cho vấn đề/kết quả xảy ra lại ở nơi khác.
items.explanationEn: replicate /ˈrep.lɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to repeat elsewhere. "Replicate a problem or result" means to make it happen again elsewhere.

items.question: Trong câu "You generate evidence — real data from a real project persuades far better than theory.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You generate evidence — real data from a real project persuades far better than theory.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. "Evidence" là danh từ không đếm được: "a piece of evidence", "generate evidence".
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): proof that supports a claim. "Evidence" is uncountable: "a piece of evidence", "generate evidence".

items.question: Trong câu "You create advocates — a successful pilot team is a more credible evangelist than any management presentation.", từ "advocate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You create advocates — a successful pilot team is a more credible evangelist than any management presentation.", what does "advocate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: advocate /ˈæd.və.kət/ (danh từ): người ủng hộ. Danh từ /ˈæd.və.kət/, động từ /ˈæd.və.keɪt/ (ủng hộ, bênh vực).
items.explanationEn: advocate /ˈæd.və.kət/ (noun): a public supporter. The noun is /ˈæd.və.kət/; the verb /ˈæd.və.keɪt/ means to support publicly.

items.question: Trong câu "You create advocates — a successful pilot team is a more credible evangelist than any management presentation.", từ "credible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You create advocates — a successful pilot team is a more credible evangelist than any management presentation.", what does "credible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: credible /ˈkred.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đáng tin. "Credible source/evidence" = nguồn/bằng chứng đáng tin; danh từ là credibility.
items.explanationEn: credible /ˈkred.ə.bəl/ (adjective): believable. "Credible source or evidence" is believable; the noun is credibility.

items.question: Trong câu "A willing team — do not force a reluctant one.", từ "reluctant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A willing team — do not force a reluctant one.", what does "reluctant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reluctant /rɪˈlʌk.tənt/ (tính từ): miễn cưỡng. "Be reluctant to do something" = ngần ngại, không muốn làm gì; trái nghĩa với willing.
items.explanationEn: reluctant /rɪˈlʌk.tənt/ (adjective): unwilling. "Be reluctant to do something" means not wanting to; the opposite of willing.

items.question: Trong câu "Understand the MECHANISM that produced the result before scaling it.", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understand the MECHANISM that produced the result before scaling it.", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế. "The mechanism behind a result" = cách thức thực sự tạo ra kết quả đó.
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (noun): the way something works. "The mechanism behind a result" is how the result was actually produced.

items.question: Trong câu "Understand the MECHANISM that produced the result before scaling it.", từ "scale" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understand the MECHANISM that produced the result before scaling it.", what does "scale" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scale /skeɪl/ (động từ): mở rộng quy mô. "Scale something" (hoặc "scale up") = mở rộng ra quy mô lớn hơn.
items.explanationEn: scale /skeɪl/ (verb): to expand in size. "Scale something" (or "scale up") means to grow it to a larger size.

items.question: Trong câu "Resistance to change is normal and predictable.", từ "resistance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Resistance to change is normal and predictable.", what does "resistance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resistance /rɪˈzɪs.təns/ (danh từ): sự kháng cự. "Resistance to change" = sự chống lại thay đổi; động từ là resist.
items.explanationEn: resistance /rɪˈzɪs.təns/ (noun): opposition to something. "Resistance to change" is opposition to it; the verb is resist.

items.question: Trong câu "keep the practice light and focused on outcomes, not on compliance.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "keep the practice light and focused on outcomes, not on compliance.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ. "Compliance with rules" = sự tuân thủ quy định; đừng nhầm với compliment (lời khen).
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following rules. "Compliance with rules" means obeying them; do not confuse with compliment.

items.question: Trong câu "if a review finds defects in my document, I look incompetent.", từ "incompetent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "if a review finds defects in my document, I look incompetent.", what does "incompetent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incompetent /ɪnˈkɒm.pɪ.tənt/ (tính từ): kém năng lực. "Look incompetent" = trông như không đủ năng lực; trái nghĩa là competent.
items.explanationEn: incompetent /ɪnˈkɒm.pɪ.tənt/ (adjective): lacking skill. "Look incompetent" means appear unskilled; the opposite is competent.

items.question: Trong câu "there is usually a legitimate reason you do not yet know.", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "there is usually a legitimate reason you do not yet know.", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (tính từ): chính đáng. "A legitimate reason" = lý do chính đáng; nghĩa khác là hợp pháp.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (adjective): reasonable and valid. "A legitimate reason" is a valid one; the word can also mean legal.

items.question: Trong câu "track actual adoption, not just whether people say they are doing it.", từ "adoption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "track actual adoption, not just whether people say they are doing it.", what does "adoption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: adoption /əˈdɒp.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc áp dụng. "Adoption of a practice/tool" = việc thực sự đưa vào sử dụng.
items.explanationEn: adoption /əˈdɒp.ʃən/ (noun): taking something into use. "Adoption of a practice or tool" means actually starting to use it.

items.question: Trong câu "you cannot justify continued investment in it.", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you cannot justify continued investment in it.", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
options: biện minh, chứng minh hợp lý
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌs.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): biện minh, chứng minh hợp lý. "Justify an investment" = đưa ra lý do cho thấy khoản đầu tư là xứng đáng.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌs.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to show to be reasonable. "Justify an investment" means to show it is worth it.

items.question: Trong câu "Only outcomes demonstrate value.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only outcomes demonstrate value.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. Bài viết đối lập outcome (kết quả thực tế) với activity (việc đã làm).
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): a result. The article contrasts outcome (real result) with activity (work done).

items.question: Trong câu "Only outcomes demonstrate value.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only outcomes demonstrate value.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (động từ): chứng minh. "Demonstrate value" = cho thấy rõ giá trị; "demo" là dạng rút gọn.
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (verb): to prove clearly. "Demonstrate value" means to show it clearly; "demo" is the short form.

items.question: Trong câu "You need a baseline.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need a baseline.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): mốc cơ sở ban đầu. "Measure a baseline" = đo mức ban đầu để so sánh sau khi thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): a starting reference point. "Measure a baseline" means record the starting level to compare against.

items.question: Trong câu "people will log typos to inflate the number.", từ "inflate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "people will log typos to inflate the number.", what does "inflate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (động từ): thổi phồng. "Inflate the numbers" = làm số liệu to hơn thực tế.
items.explanationEn: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (verb): to increase artificially. "Inflate the numbers" means make them look bigger than they really are.

items.question: Trong câu "Improved communication and trust between the team and the customer is very real but hard to quantify.", từ "quantify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Improved communication and trust between the team and the customer is very real but hard to quantify.", what does "quantify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: quantify /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): định lượng. "Hard to quantify" = khó đo bằng con số.
items.explanationEn: quantify /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to express as a number. "Hard to quantify" means difficult to express as a number.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not dismiss an improvement just because you cannot measure it.", từ "dismiss" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not dismiss an improvement just because you cannot measure it.", what does "dismiss" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dismiss /dɪˈsmɪs/ (động từ): gạt bỏ, xem nhẹ. "Dismiss an idea" = gạt đi, không coi trọng; "dismiss an employee" = sa thải.
items.explanationEn: dismiss /dɪˈsmɪs/ (verb): to reject as unimportant. "Dismiss an idea" means to disregard it; "dismiss an employee" means to fire them.

items.question: Trong câu "Three features that distinguish a risk from a problem:", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three features that distinguish a risk from a problem:", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. "Distinguish A from B" = phân biệt A với B.
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. "Distinguish A from B" means to tell A and B apart.

items.question: Trong câu "A risk can be mitigated in advance — this is exactly the value of managing it.", từ "mitigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A risk can be mitigated in advance — this is exactly the value of managing it.", what does "mitigate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mitigate /ˈmɪt.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): giảm nhẹ. "Mitigate a risk" = giảm xác suất hoặc tác động của rủi ro; danh từ là mitigation.
items.explanationEn: mitigate /ˈmɪt.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to make less severe. "Mitigate a risk" means to reduce its probability or impact; the noun is mitigation.

items.question: Trong câu "The reason: they have amplified impact.", từ "amplify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reason: they have amplified impact.", what does "amplify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: amplify /ˈæm.plɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): khuếch đại. "Amplified impact" = tác động được khuếch đại, lớn hơn nhiều.
items.explanationEn: amplify /ˈæm.plɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make larger. "Amplified impact" is an effect made much larger.

items.question: Trong câu "and usually surfaces only when it is too late to fix cheaply.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and usually surfaces only when it is too late to fix cheaply.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. Động từ "surface" = nổi lên, lộ ra; danh từ nghĩa là bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to become visible. The verb "surface" means to emerge; the noun means the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not use unproven technology for a critical component", từ "unproven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not use unproven technology for a critical component", what does "unproven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unproven /ʌnˈpruː.vən/ (tính từ): chưa được kiểm chứng. "Unproven technology" = công nghệ chưa được chứng minh là hoạt động tốt.
items.explanationEn: unproven /ʌnˈpruː.vən/ (adjective): not yet shown to work. "Unproven technology" has not yet shown it works reliably.

items.question: Trong câu "Put a clause in the vendor contract", từ "clause" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Put a clause in the vendor contract", what does "clause" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clause /klɔːz/ (danh từ): điều khoản. "Contract clause" = điều khoản hợp đồng; trong SQL, "WHERE clause" = mệnh đề WHERE.
items.explanationEn: clause /klɔːz/ (noun): a section of a contract. "Contract clause" is a section of a contract; in SQL a "WHERE clause" is part of a query.

items.question: Trong câu "Do nothing, but deliberately and with a contingency plan", từ "contingency plan" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do nothing, but deliberately and with a contingency plan", what does "contingency plan" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: contingency plan /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si plæn/ (cụm từ): kế hoạch dự phòng. "Contingency plan" = phương án dự phòng nếu sự cố xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: contingency plan /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si plæn/ (phrase): a backup plan. "Contingency plan" is what you do if something goes wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "but only when it is a conscious, recorded decision.", từ "conscious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "but only when it is a conscious, recorded decision.", what does "conscious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conscious /ˈkɒn.ʃəs/ (tính từ): có chủ đích. "Conscious decision" = quyết định có ý thức, biết rõ mình chọn gì.
items.explanationEn: conscious /ˈkɒn.ʃəs/ (adjective): intentional. "Conscious decision" is made knowingly and on purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "requirements based on guesswork; new requirements appearing late.", từ "guesswork" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "requirements based on guesswork; new requirements appearing late.", what does "guesswork" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guesswork /ˈɡes.wɜːk/ (danh từ): sự phỏng đoán. "Based on guesswork" = dựa trên đoán mò, không có thông tin chắc chắn.
items.explanationEn: guesswork /ˈɡes.wɜːk/ (noun): guessing. "Based on guesswork" means built on guesses rather than facts.

items.question: Trong câu "agree the time commitment up front", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "agree the time commitment up front", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Agree something up front" = thống nhất ngay từ đầu; "pay up front" = trả trước.
items.explanationEn: up front /ʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): at the start. "Agree something up front" means at the beginning; "pay up front" means pay in advance.

items.question: Trong câu "escalate early when people are absent", từ "escalate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "escalate early when people are absent", what does "escalate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to raise to a higher level
items.explanation: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (động từ): báo lên cấp trên. "Escalate an issue" = chuyển vấn đề lên cấp có thẩm quyền cao hơn.
items.explanationEn: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (verb): to raise to a higher level. "Escalate an issue" means to pass it to someone with more authority.

items.question: Trong câu "developers build the wrong thing; acceptance disputes.", từ "dispute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "developers build the wrong thing; acceptance disputes.", what does "dispute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (danh từ): tranh chấp. "Acceptance dispute" = tranh cãi về việc sản phẩm có được nghiệm thu hay không.
items.explanationEn: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (noun): a disagreement. "Acceptance dispute" is an argument over whether the product is accepted.

items.question: Trong câu "verify understanding by asking them to paraphrase", từ "paraphrase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "verify understanding by asking them to paraphrase", what does "paraphrase" (verb) mean?
options: diễn đạt lại bằng lời khác
items.explanation: paraphrase /ˈpær.ə.freɪz/ (động từ): diễn đạt lại bằng lời khác. Nhờ người khác paraphrase giúp kiểm tra họ có hiểu đúng yêu cầu không.
items.explanationEn: paraphrase /ˈpær.ə.freɪz/ (verb): to restate in other words. Asking someone to paraphrase checks whether they really understood.

items.question: Trong câu "the project never finishes; the team burns out.", từ "burn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the project never finishes; the team burns out.", what does "burn out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): kiệt sức. "Burn out" = kiệt sức vì làm việc quá tải kéo dài; danh từ là burnout.
items.explanationEn: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (phrase): to become exhausted. "Burn out" means to be exhausted by long overwork; the noun is burnout.

items.question: Trong câu "measure and present the cumulative effort of all changes", từ "cumulative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "measure and present the cumulative effort of all changes", what does "cumulative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cumulative /ˈkjuː.mjə.lə.tɪv/ (tính từ): cộng dồn, tích lũy. "Cumulative effort" = tổng công sức cộng dồn từ nhiều thay đổi nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: cumulative /ˈkjuː.mjə.lə.tɪv/ (adjective): added up over time. "Cumulative effort" is the total built up from many small changes.

items.question: Trong câu "impose a quota on the high-priority tier", từ "quota" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "impose a quota on the high-priority tier", what does "quota" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quota /ˈkwəʊ.tə/ (danh từ): hạn ngạch. "Impose a quota" = đặt giới hạn số lượng tối đa; ví dụ chỉ 20% yêu cầu được ưu tiên cao.
items.explanationEn: quota /ˈkwəʊ.tə/ (noun): a fixed maximum share. "Impose a quota" means to set a maximum amount, e.g. only 20% can be high priority.

items.question: Trong câu "record what must outlive team memory", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "record what must outlive team memory", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. "Outlive something" = còn tồn tại sau khi thứ đó mất đi.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. "Outlive something" means to still exist after it is gone.

items.question: Trong câu "share knowledge through reviews; rotate roles.", từ "rotate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "share knowledge through reviews; rotate roles.", what does "rotate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rotate /rəʊˈteɪt/ (động từ): luân phiên. "Rotate roles" = thay phiên nhau đảm nhận vai trò; "rotate keys" = thay khóa định kỳ.
items.explanationEn: rotate /rəʊˈteɪt/ (verb): to take turns. "Rotate roles" means people take turns; "rotate keys" means replace them regularly.

items.question: Trong câu "Impact — how severe if it occurs.", từ "severe" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Impact — how severe if it occurs.", what does "severe" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: severe /sɪˈvɪə/ (tính từ): nghiêm trọng. Danh từ severity = mức độ nghiêm trọng, hay dùng khi phân loại lỗi.
items.explanationEn: severe /sɪˈvɪə/ (adjective): very serious. The noun severity is often used to rank bugs.

items.question: Trong câu "what signals that the risk is materialising?", từ "materialise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "what signals that the risk is materialising?", what does "materialise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: materialise /məˈtɪə.ri.ə.laɪz/ (động từ): trở thành hiện thực. "A risk materialises" = rủi ro thực sự xảy ra; Anh-Mỹ viết materialize.
items.explanationEn: materialise /məˈtɪə.ri.ə.laɪz/ (verb): to actually happen. "A risk materialises" means it actually happens; US spelling is materialize.

items.question: Trong câu "If the risk list lives in a file nobody opens, it functionally does not exist.", từ "functionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the risk list lives in a file nobody opens, it functionally does not exist.", what does "functionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: functionally /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): trên thực tế. "Functionally does not exist" = xét về tác dụng thì coi như không tồn tại.
items.explanationEn: functionally /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən.əl.i/ (adverb): in practical effect. "Functionally does not exist" means it has no practical effect at all.

items.question: Trong câu "filed in the project plan, and never looked at again", từ "file" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "filed in the project plan, and never looked at again", what does "file" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: file /faɪl/ (động từ): lưu vào hồ sơ. "File a document" = cất vào hồ sơ; "file a bug" = tạo báo cáo lỗi.
items.explanationEn: file /faɪl/ (verb): to store in records. "File a document" means store it; "file a bug" means submit a bug report.

items.question: Trong câu "just in a lighter form, usually revisited during retrospectives and planning sessions.", từ "revisit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "just in a lighter form, usually revisited during retrospectives and planning sessions.", what does "revisit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: revisit /ˌriːˈvɪz.ɪt/ (động từ): xem xét lại. "Revisit a decision/risk" = xem xét lại vấn đề đó.
items.explanationEn: revisit /ˌriːˈvɪz.ɪt/ (verb): to reconsider. "Revisit a decision or risk" means to look at it again.

items.question: Trong câu "Retrospectives must be completely separated from individual evaluation, or nobody speaks honestly.", từ "retrospective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retrospectives must be completely separated from individual evaluation, or nobody speaks honestly.", what does "retrospective" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an art exhibition of past works
a review meeting on past work
items.explanation: retrospective /ˌret.rəˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): buổi họp nhìn lại. Retrospective (retro) là buổi họp cuối dự án/sprint để rút kinh nghiệm.
items.explanationEn: retrospective /ˌret.rəˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a review meeting on past work. A retrospective (retro) is a meeting after a project or sprint to learn lessons.

items.question: Trong câu "A problem recurring across projects is a PROCESS defect, not an isolated incident.", từ "isolated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A problem recurring across projects is a PROCESS defect, not an isolated incident.", what does "isolated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: isolated /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): riêng lẻ, đơn lẻ. "An isolated incident" = sự cố đơn lẻ, không mang tính hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: isolated /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): happening only once. "An isolated incident" is a one-off, not a pattern.

items.question: Trong câu "it differs entirely from ignoring it.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it differs entirely from ignoring it.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ə/ (động từ): khác biệt. "Differ from" = khác với; đừng nhầm với defer (trì hoãn).
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ə/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from" means to be unlike; do not confuse with defer.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements engineering is building shared understanding good enough to proceed at acceptable risk", từ "proceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements engineering is building shared understanding good enough to proceed at acceptable risk", what does "proceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: proceed /prəˈsiːd/ (động từ): tiến hành, đi tiếp. "Proceed with something" = tiếp tục thực hiện việc gì.
items.explanationEn: proceed /prəˈsiːd/ (verb): to go forward. "Proceed with something" means to continue doing it.

items.question: Trong câu "be honest when results fall short.", từ "fall short" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "be honest when results fall short.", what does "fall short" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to fail to meet a standard
items.explanation: fall short /fɔːl ʃɔːt/ (cụm từ): không đạt kỳ vọng. "Fall short (of expectations)" = không đạt mức mong đợi.
items.explanationEn: fall short /fɔːl ʃɔːt/ (phrase): to fail to meet a standard. "Fall short (of expectations)" means not reaching the expected level.
